headline: Coinbase Insures User Funds Safe Following Third-Party Vendor Data Breach
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase stated that its own systems were not breached after a security incident at third-party analytics firm Amplitude exposed customer contact information.
why: Third-party vendor vulnerabilities remain a key operational risk vector for centralized digital asset platforms and user privacy.

impacts.name: Coinbase Global Inc
impacts.why: While funds remain secure, data leaks involving customer contacts can temporarily dent platform trust and elevate regulatory scrutiny.
